framework.summary: Large frontier developers with New Jersey users must write and implement risk protocols and review them yearly.
framework.quote: write and implement technical and organizational protocols to assess and reduce the risk

transparency_report.summary: Developers must file a yearly Risk Management Disclosure and a New Model Risk Disclosure with the Attorney General, who publishes them.
transparency_report.quote: annually submit to the Attorney General a "Risk Management Disclosure"

incident_reporting.summary: The bill requires no incident reporting.

imminent_risk_reporting.summary: The bill sets no imminent-risk reporting window.

third_party_audit.summary: The Attorney General may audit developers or hire a private auditor; developers themselves need not obtain an audit.
third_party_audit.quote: enter into a contract with a private entity to conduct an audit

whistleblower.summary: The bill has no whistleblower protection.

registration.summary: Developers must file a New Model Risk Disclosure with the Attorney General before or when deploying a new model; this is notice, not a licence.
registration.quote: before, or concurrently with, deploying a new frontier model

shutdown.summary: The bill requires no shutdown capability.

compute_threshold.summary: A frontier developer used at least 10^26 integer or floating-point operations to train a frontier model.
compute_threshold.quote: a quantity of computing power of at least 10^26 integer or floating-point operations to train a frontier model

revenue_threshold.summary: A large frontier developer, with affiliates, had annual gross revenues above $100 million in the preceding calendar year.
revenue_threshold.quote: annual gross revenues in excess of $100 million in the preceding calendar year

harm_threshold.summary: Catastrophic harm means death or serious injury of 25 or more people, or $1 billion in property damage, from a single incident.
harm_threshold.quote: death or serious injury of 25 or more people or $1 billion in damage to, or loss of, property arising from a single incident

penalties.summary: $100,000 civil penalty per violation for missing or materially false disclosures, collected by the Attorney General; no penalty for a materially false statement made in good faith and reasonable (Sec. 4(b)).
penalties.quote: shall be liable for a civil penalty in the amount of $100,000 for each violation

effective_date.summary: Takes effect six months after enactment; sections 1 through 6 expire five years later.
effective_date.quote: This act shall take effect six months after the date of enactment.

notes: Entry key names Assembly companion A5275; its text was not read.
